tweets.text:
Hi Mark, FRD msig signer here, I was not on great terms with PleasrDAO back then so hopefully this can be read objectively.

There were two competing proposals at the time to drain the treasury into a new DAO. Both sides attempted to get the blessing of Ross's family. Both were rejected and the msig chose to honor Ross's family's wishes in winding down FRD due to their legal concerns. Ultimately Ross was freed, so I think we can consider it a resounding success. The rest of the money is still in the redemption pool for the token holders. As per request of the family this money could never have been realistically used for prison reform as you say.

Earlier this year I did some digging regarding the original NFT in the contract. It's intended to be in fractional control of a previous snapshot of large FREE holders, one of the largest being Pleasr. I believe it is recoverable, but it would effectively rug the token holders, so this should not be pursued. Pleasr has entirely new management now if you wiash to discuss this.

For Artizen, investors have essentially been 0'd, with no more financial information from Rene than anyone else has received. I am in contact with other community members and would love it if we could help each other piece this together while we wait to get contact from the Artizen team.
